text:
Sam W: quick async ask — can someone run a narrow microbench + quality pass for the new int4+fp8 combo on the 'helpdesk' prompt slice? need latency delta, p95, and a quick BLEU-ish quality snapshot vs int8 baseline. target: batch sizes 1,4,8.

Maya K: +1. do we have an approved promptset file? should we include the long-turn edgecases? :eyes:

Sam W: use helpdesk_prompts_v3.txt (filtered for long/short). include long-turns as a separate split. no need for full eval, just 100 samples each split.

Anika R: I can kick this off later today. quick question: which model binary should I pick? redwood-v1-int4-fp8 or redwood-v1-hybrid-int4fp8?

Sam W: start with redwood-v1-hybrid-int4fp8 (closest to runtime canary). if that looks good we can try the straight int4-fp8 binary.

Jorge L: dropping the command I'll run for reproducibility:
```
./qbench \
  --model redwood-v1-hybrid-int4fp8 \
  --prompts helpdesk_prompts_v3.txt \
  --split long,short \
  --batch-sizes 1,4,8 \
  --repeats 3 \
  --out bench/2365007777.json
```

BenchBot: job queued — id=job-89234, expected runtime ~45m, node pool=gpu-dedicated-rtx6000. logs: https://internal/bench/job-89234

Anika R: started run on job-89234. will post p95/throughput and a tiny quality table when done. if anything fails ping infra.

(infra-bot): job-89234 allocated on host rtx6000-07, pinned to 2 GPUs, CUDA 12.1. If you need additional memory bump, reply here.

Maya K: small ask — can you include tokenization parity check vs int8 baseline? last time we saw subtle tokenization differences on long-turns.

Anika R: will include quick tokenization parity diff (counts + top-3 mismatched tokens). also adding a one-off BLEU-like score and a human-sample of 6 mismatches.

BenchBot: job-89234 finished — results uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/2365007777/bench-v1.json

Anika R: paste of the quick summary (abridged):
```
p95 latency (ms): int8-baseline: 210 | hybrid-int4fp8: 165 (-21%)
throughput (tok/s): int8: 980 | hybrid-int4fp8: 1250 (+27%)
batch=1 p50 latency: 132 -> 105
quality(proxy BLEU): int8: 0.77 | hybrid-int4fp8: 0.74 (delta -0.03)
long-turn mismatch rate: 6/100 vs 3/100 (int8)
tokenization parity: 99.1% same tokens; top mismatches: ['—', '…', '—more']
```

Sam W: nice perf uplift. quality delta seems small but non-trivial on long-turns. next steps: can we run a small eval with 500 long-turns tomorrow and capture logits snapshots for 10 mismatches? also tag model binary + quant params used.

Anika R: sure. I'll schedule a larger run and add logits dumps for 10 fails. model metadata: redwood-v1-hybrid-int4fp8@rev-2026-03-15, quant-config: {"scale_init":"calib-per-layer","fp8-mode":"e4m3"}.

Jorge L: fyi, if that looks marginal we can try adjusting per-head scaling — I think we can recover some of the long-turn accuracy at cost of 5-7% throughput. want me to prototype?

Maya K: please prototype. also adding checklist for release notes: quantify p95 improvement, quality delta, and an explicit fallback policy (route to int8 for identified prompts).

Sam W: thanks everyone. tagging @Maya K and @Jorge L for follow-ups. I'll open a PR with the perf/quality summary and proposed fallback rules once the 500-sample run completes. :thumbsup:

Anika R: leaving raw outputs in bench dir and I also uploaded 6 human examples to gdrive: https://drive.internal/redwood/bench/2365007777/samples.zip

Maya K: ack, will review tomorrow morning.

Sam W: closing the loop — great async run. we'll sync if the larger eval changes the signal. :white_check_mark:
